method: Read-only production Supabase public.ayas Arabic/English and direct public.cross_references. Compare exact source and target claims and contexts. A flagged link is not automatically an error or deletion approval; no scholarly tafsir edition was checked.

flags.reason: Warner called magician/liar versus destruction of earlier generations; not a close parallel.
Objection to monotheism versus objections to a messenger's ordinary human circumstances.
Challenge to recipient of revelation versus taking Allah as protector.
Divine mercy's treasuries versus taking Allah as protector; generic divine sovereignty only.
Defeat of hostile parties versus taking Allah as protector.
Messengers denied and punishment deserved versus taking Allah as protector.
One blast of judgment versus denial of resurrection of bones; only broad eschatological association.
Mocking request to hasten judgment versus taking Allah as protector.
David's strength and repentance versus Solomon's wind; different person and proposition.
Mountains praising with David versus Solomon's wind; correct 34:10/21:79 are closer.
Birds praising with David versus Solomon's wind; correct 34:10/21:79 are closer.
David's two litigants versus Israelites requesting a king; no specific common narrative.
Ninety-nine ewes and one ewe versus Israelites requesting a king.
David's ruling about ewes versus Israelites requesting a king.
Moral distinction between righteous and wicked versus hypothetical divine diversion; mismatch.
Solomon given to David versus Israelites praying before Goliath; indirect broader era only.
Solomon's horses versus Israelites praying before Goliath.
Solomon's reflection on horses versus Israelites praying before Goliath.
Solomon's horses' legs/necks versus Israelites praying before Goliath.
Solomon's trial and throne versus Israelites praying before Goliath.
Solomon commanding wind versus Israelites praying before Goliath.
Solomon's builders/divers versus Israelites praying before Goliath.
Bound jinn versus Israelites praying before Goliath.
God's gift to Solomon versus Israelites praying before Goliath.
Solomon's reward versus Israelites praying before Goliath.
Job's family restored versus Moses and Aaron's mission; different named figures.
Job's oath and patience versus Israelites praying before Goliath.

candidates.reason: David and mountains praising God together; shared Arabic الجبال and David.
David's birds participating in praise; 34:10 explicitly names birds.
Direct moral contrast of righteous believers versus evildoers, shared construction أم نجعل.
Explicit call to ponder revelation; يدبروا versus يتدبرون.
David–Solomon relationship, though one describes gift and the other inheritance.
Wind subjected to Solomon in both; الريح and سليمان.
Devils/jinn diving and working for Solomon; الشياطين and diving يغوصون.
Builders for Solomon; 34:13 describes their building works, not diving.
Nearly identical Arabic phrasing: وآتيناه أهله ومثلهم معهم رحمة ... وذكرى.
Abraham, Isaac and Jacob; overlap in named persons, different narrative emphasis.

findings: Multiple 38:31–44 verses point to 2:250 (Goliath-era prayer), including Solomon's wind, jinn and Job's oath. This is strong evidence of a systematic broad/misassigned linking pattern; investigate provenance and neighboring surahs before changing data.
safety: No database modifications. Do not import old HTML JSON. Preserve 11,883 cleaned rows, all Surah 39 179 rows, and audit/change logs.
